accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text against #0A0A0A or card backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:outline-none
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

3d_libraries.usage: Use for the 'Robo-Core' on the landing page. A glowing, rotating 3D node network/sphere to represent 'The Hive' and 'Synapse'.
3d_libraries.implementation: Wrap in <Suspense fallback={<Loader />}>. Ensure transparent background <Canvas gl={{ alpha: true }}>.

images.description: Purple and blue abstract neural network pattern on a black background. Use as a low-opacity overlay or hero background.
Futuristic humanoid robot with glowing elements. Use for 'The Hive' module marketing section.

icons.weight: Use strokeWidth={1.5} for a premium, delicate look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, lucide-react, reactflow.
Create the Landing Page (marketing) with an immersive Hero section featuring the 3D 'Robo-Core' using R3F.
Implement 'The Synapse' using reactflow. Nodes must have the glassmorphism aesthetic (bg-[#0A0A0A]/60, border-white/10).
Build Dashboards (/sentry, /pulse, /hive) using the High Density Grid. Do NOT use standard white cards; use dark glassmorphism.
Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT use #7351B7 or #1B93A4. Use #8B5CF6 for the primary purple glow.
Do not use transparent backgrounds blindly; headers over content must use heavy backdrop-blur and border-b.
All buttons, inputs, links, and actionable items MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Ensure all components use generic div elements for containers in the marketing pages to avoid Shadcn limitations, while utilizing Shadcn components heavily styled for internal dashboards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and selection states.
MUST use data-testid on all interactive and key informational elements.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
